Blackburn Rovers Boosted by Returning Duo for Swansea City Clash

04 Nov 2026, 02:28 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.bbc.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysBlackburn Rovers have received a timely boost ahead of their EFL Championship match against Swansea City, with manager Tony Mowbray confirming that Yuri Ribeiro and Yuki Ohashi are set to travel with the squad and feature on the substitutes' bench.

Team News and Squad Updates Ahead of the Championship Fixture

Blackburn Rovers have received a timely boost ahead of their EFL Championship match against Swansea City, with manager Tony Mowbray confirming that Yuri Ribeiro and Yuki Ohashi are set to travel with the squad and feature on the substitutes' bench.

Both players have been sidelined with hamstring injuries: Ribeiro has been out of action for the past month, while Ohashi has endured a two-month absence. Their expected return to the matchday squad provides added depth for Rovers as they prepare for the Saturday fixture.

  • Yuri Ribeiro: Returning after a one-month absence due to a hamstring injury.
  • Yuki Ohashi: Available again following a two-month layoff from a hamstring issue.
  • Kristi Montgomery: In contention to return after missing the recent win against Wrexham, having completed full training.

Injury Setbacks and Squad Management

While several players are making their way back to full fitness, the club confirmed a fresh setback for Mathias Jorgensen. Following a hamstring issue earlier in the month, Jorgensen has suffered a recurrence that will keep him sidelined for an estimated three more weeks.

Manager Tony Mowbray emphasized the importance of supporting the player's mental well-being alongside his physical recovery, noting that the club has granted Jorgensen time to visit his family and recover from the disappointment of breaking down just as he neared full fitness.

  • Mathias Jorgensen: Set for approximately three more weeks on the sidelines due to a hamstring setback.
  • Support: Given time with family to cope with the psychological impact of the repeated injury.

This upcoming Championship fixture takes place away from home against Swansea City.
